newsitem.title: USA: Standard Micro, Acer resolve dispute.
newsitem.headline: Standard Micro, Acer resolve dispute.

text.p: Standard Microsystems Corp said on Monday that it and Acer Laboratories Inc of Taiwan have resolved a contract dispute over Standard's patented Digital Data Separator technology used in certain Acer products.

Standard said it will receive higher royalty payments from Acer for products under dispute. The new agreement will also encourage customers to standardize on Standard's I/O architectures and make it easier for them to transition to Standard's next generation I/O devices, Standard said.

The settlement also allows Acer's customers to be assured they will continue to receive products from Acer uninterrupted, Standard said. For any product Acer agrees to phase out due to marketing or other considerations, reasonable transition time will be given to customers who have designed-in products.
Standard makes products for the computer peripherals market. Acer makes integrated circuits.
